messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Dedicated pool dpool-mh-3 (tenant: MeridianHealth) sustained GPU utilization >= 97% for 7m, request queue length rising, 429s increasing. Severity: P1.
oncall-sam: acked. pulling metrics and logs. tagging incident.
sre-ani: joining — what's the tenant config (max/soft limits)?
infra-bot: pool metadata: pool_id=dpool-mh-3; tenant=MeridianHealth; nodes=6; gpus_per_node=8; total_gpus=48; tenant_max_gpus=48; shared_reserve=16 (shared, billing_tag=burstable); autoscaler_policy=conservative_capacity; preemptible_allowed=true.
eng-runtime-zhou: Any recent deployments or spike patterns? Could be a scheduled job. Also check KV cache locks — long-lived sessions can hold slots.
account-lina: FYI I had a morning sync with MeridianHealth; they said an internal data-import + eval kicked off at 08:15 UTC but they expected it to ramp slowly. Will ping them for confirmation.
meridian-ops: (MeridianHealth) Confirmed we started a parallelized evaluation across 6 models at 08:12 UTC, ~20k items. We expected runs to use batching and respect rate limits. We're pausing if needed.
oncall-sam: current: GPUs pegged, queue ~900 reqs, 429 rate ~9% over last 10m. Autoscaler didn't increase because tenant_max_gpus reached. There is shared_reserve available but policy requires manual approval for cross-tenant borrow.
sre-ani: mitigation options: A) borrow from shared_reserve (fast, billable to tenant) B) evict preemptible/long-idle sessions C) route non-critical eval traffic to hosted fallback or lower-precision replicas D) ask customer to pause. We should coordinate which to do first.
eng-runtime-zhou: We have a runtime trick: can on-the-fly compile a Q8 INT8 variant for meridian-13b that reduces GPU memory/compute by ~30% but needs ~45s to warm up. If we can route a fraction to it, overall pressure will drop. It's not lossless but ok for evals.
account-lina: MeridianHealth says they can pause the heavy evals for 20-30m if we need. They asked whether we can avoid evicting interactive sessions (they have clinicians testing).
sre-ani: Ok hold interactive sessions. We'll avoid evict unless confirmed. Let's do borrow + runtime fallback + ask them to pause the batch. I'll request borrow now.
sam: running command:
```
redwoodctl dedicated borrow --pool dpool-mh-3 --gpus 8 --from shared_reserve --tag emergency_burst --note "tenant pool exhausted; short-term mitigation"
```
infra-bot: Borrow request received. Policy: borrow <= 8GPUs auto-approve if tag==emergency_burst and billing_consent==true. Tenant billing_consent flag: false. Account rep needs to confirm billing consent to auto-approve.
account-lina: MeridianHealth, we need permission to bill this burst to your account (temporary). Can you confirm?
meridian-ops: Confirmed — OK to bill burst for this window. Please proceed.
infra-bot: Borrow auto-approved. Allocated +8 GPUs from shared_reserve to dpool-mh-3. New total_gpus=56 (temporary).
sre-ani: Monitoring. Queue dropped to ~300 within 3m. 429s down to 1.8%. Latency still slightly elevated for a subset of requests.
eng-runtime-zhou: I'm flipping traffic for evals to the Q8 variant (gradual):
```
redwoodctl routing set --tenant MeridianHealth --match "model:meridian-13b,op:batch" --route-to meridian-13b-q8 --weight 70 --reason "emergency compute reduction"
```
deploy-bot: Routing change deployed to edge config within 30s.
eng-runtime-zhou: Q8 instances are warming — they will hit steady-state in ~90s. Expect further reduction in GPU load.
sre-ani: Customer paused manual batch at 08:25 UTC per account rep, thank you. That plus borrow and routing reduced pressure; GPUs now at ~72% average.
account-lina: MeridianHealth confirmed pause. They also requested we not evict sessions and asked for a brief summary for their ops team.
sre-ani: Good. Additional safety step: limit new heavy batch starts from tenant for next 2h via tenant-policy throttle. Command: 
```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant MeridianHealth --policy "batch_rate_limit=20/min,block_new_batch_jobs=true" --ttl 7200 --note "post-incident safeguard"
```
oncall-sam: applied tenant throttle.
eng-runtime-zhou: Observed one strange thing: autoscaler logs show it measured increased allocation but respected tenant_max_gpus exactly. It did not attempt cross-reserve borrow automatically. Looks like conservative autoscaler policy doesn't consider scheduled batch flag.
sre-ani: Post-incident action: request autoscaler change to allow auto-borrow up to X% when sustained queue > 400 AND tenant has billing_consent=true. Creating ticket.
oncall-sam: I'm going to hand off monitoring to SRE Ani. Sam stepping off in 10m.
sre-ani: Taking over. I'll keep watch and update every 10m. Current status: mitigated / stable. Customer impact: brief elevated 429s and slower tails from 08:18-08:27 UTC; no data loss; interactive sessions preserved.
account-lina: Customer appreciates the rapid help, asks for a permanent quota increase discussion. I'll open a billing request and schedule a follow-up.
eng-runtime-zhou: Action items for runtime: 1) add on-the-fly quantized warm pool for large tenants with frequent batch jobs 2) add flag to routing to drain to q8 with canary 3) test autoscaler auto-borrow logic in staging.
sre-ani: Action items for infra: 1) add alert: per-tenant sustained queue > 500 for 5m 2) make borrow approval flow faster when account rep+billing_consent present 3) document commands used in playbook.
infra-bot: Note: borrowed gpus will be charged to tenant account and reclaimed after 60m unless extended. Reclaim scheduled at 09:25 UTC.
meridian-ops: We'll review quota needs and follow up via CS. Thanks for keeping interactive sessions intact.
account-lina: Filing support ticket for quota increase and billing consent formalization.
oncall-sam: marking incident mitigated at 08:30 UTC. Handoff complete. Sam out. :wave:
sre-ani: I'll draft a short post-incident summary and propose the autoscaler policy changes. Will post timeline + logs in the postmortem channel.
eng-runtime-zhou: One more note for the record: Q8 routing caused minor quality variance for one of the evaluation models; customer aware and OK with results for now. Documenting in ticket.
sre-ani: Closing this thread for now. Will reopen if regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
